interpretation: Intentional negative controls, missing upstream companions and unavailable historical fixtures are not all Federation incompatibilities. This is not a production pass-rate benchmark.
An exit-zero server without compat-report.json is not a passing GameTest run. Timeout hints show the first recognized error, not necessarily terminal state.

All production server comparisons use the same production JAR SHA256. Three ordinary fixture snapshots occur; their changed class entries and per-run hashes are preserved. No assertion of identical fixture bytecode across the matrix is made.
Results qualify each exact dependency tuple and selected feature, not the full cross-product of optional addons or all versions between tested endpoints.

All mod artifacts and servers are real. Some existing chest-machine processing/cancellation fixtures manually control outputs. The native UselessMod differential uses its actual alloy furnace on a joined AE2 grid.
The two client runs use the development runtime (AE2 19.2.17 / LDLib2 2.2.34 / NeoForge 21.1.250), not the packaged-server AE2 19.2.18 tuple. UI input is synthetic and screenshots are real.
No production Java/dependency version-range change is part of this investigation; historical test-fixture APIs must not be promoted to production requirements.
